sprint.name: Feature Views - Implementation from TDD Specifications
sprint.objective: Implement 3 feature views (Events, Fleet, CFN Loop) from existing comprehensive TDD test specifications

sprint_3.3_achievements.tdd_foundation: 1500+ lines of test specifications serve as implementation contracts

gap_analysis.current_state: 3 views are 16-line stubs with comprehensive test coverage
gap_analysis.target_state: 3 views fully implemented matching test specifications

acceptance_criteria.description: Events view fully implemented matching 542-line test specification
details: Full-text search on event data, agent ID, type
Filters: category (5 types), severity (4 types), date range
Virtual scrolling with react-window (600px height, 120px items)
WebSocket subscription to 'event:stream' with real-time updates
All data-testid attributes from test spec

acceptance_criteria.description: Fleet view fully implemented matching test specification
details: Aggregation cards (4 metrics: total agents, active swarms, avg confidence, tasks completed)
Virtual scrolling (400px height, dynamic item size)
Pie chart for agent distribution (Chart.js integration from Sprint 3.3)
All data-testid attributes from test spec

acceptance_criteria.description: CFN Loop view fully implemented matching test specification
details: Phase timeline (horizontal, 4 phases with sprint indicators)
Current loop status card (Loop 0-4, phase name, confidence, validators)
Metrics cards (gate threshold, consensus threshold, avg Loop 3, avg Loop 2)
Progress bars for Loop 3 and Loop 2 with threshold indicators
All data-testid attributes from test spec
E2E tests: events-view.spec.ts (10), fleet-view.spec.ts (11), cfn-loop-view.spec.ts (11) all pass

implementation_guide: Import EventTimelineItem from web-components
Use eventsStore for state management (filters, search, date range)
Implement virtual scrolling with FixedSizeList (height: 600, itemSize: 120)
Add WebSocket subscription via useWebSocketEvent('event:stream', handler)
Implement filter logic: category, severity, search, date range
Add statistics chips (total events, filtered count)
Add data-testid attributes matching test expectations
Use agentStore for fleet aggregation
Implement 4 aggregation cards (total agents, active swarms, avg confidence, tasks)
Add Grid/List toggle with ToggleButtonGroup
Implement virtual scrolling with VariableSizeList
Integrate Pie chart from Sprint 3.3 (agent distribution)
Add WebSocket subscriptions: 'agent:update', 'swarm:update'
Add swarm status breakdown chips
Add data-testid attributes matching test expectations
Use cfnLoopStore (created in Sprint 3.3)
Implement phase timeline with Box display flex (4 phases horizontal)
Add sprint chips for each phase (Chip component)
Implement current loop status card with confidence and validators
Add 4 metrics cards: gate threshold, consensus threshold, avg Loop 3, avg Loop 2
Implement dual progress bars (LinearProgress) for Loop 3 and Loop 2
Add threshold indicators on progress bars
Add WebSocket subscription: 'cfn.loop.update'
Add data-testid attributes matching test expectations

loop3_agents.focus: Implement 3 views matching TDD specifications with all features, WebSocket integration, and data-testid attributes
deliverables: Events.tsx (486 lines) - timeline, search, filters, virtual scrolling
Fleet.tsx (392 lines) - aggregation, grid/list toggle, Pie chart integration
CFNLoop.tsx (360 lines) - phase timeline, metrics cards, progress bars

loop2_validators.focus: Validate implementations match TDD specifications, all tests pass, acceptance criteria met
Code quality analysis, verify no duplication, proper TypeScript patterns, memoization
Execute all 1500+ tests, verify coverage ≥80%, validate performance benchmarks
Validate virtual scrolling performance, WebSocket latency, memory leak prevention

sprint_3.3_outputs: useWebSocketEvent hook with cleanup (memory leak fixed)
Chart.js components (Pie chart in Fleet view)
TDD specifications (1500+ lines of test code)

test_execution_timeout.risk: Tests may timeout if implementations incomplete
test_execution_timeout.mitigation: Implement views incrementally, run tests frequently, use TDD red-green-refactor

websocket_integration.risk: Real-time updates may not work correctly
websocket_integration.mitigation: Use proven useWebSocketEvent pattern from Sprint 3.3, test with mock events

performance.risk: Virtual scrolling may not be smooth with large datasets
performance.mitigation: Use react-window patterns from Sprint 3.3, test with 10K+ items, profile rendering
